category: premium-account reseller (Indonesian: rupiah prices, six named Indonesian banks)

free_tier.stated: No free tier. Debrid-Link terms in rupiah: 'Premium 15 hari Rp 62.000', 'Premium 30 hari Rp 85.000', 'Premium 90 hari Rp 186.000', 'Premium 180 hari Rp 350.000', 'Premium 360 hari Rp 618.000'.
free_tier.notes: Prices are the reseller's; it also prints a per-day figure (Rp 2.833/day at 30 days).

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable; the reseller restates Debrid-Link's own limit as 'Bandwidth Limit 400 GB/hari'

egress.terms: Debrid-Link's own: the reseller's data sheet says 'Bandwidth Limit 400 GB/hari' with parallel downloads, resume and torrent download supported.

interface_detail: Web shop in Indonesian; order confirmation by WhatsApp ('JIKA ADA MASALAH TRANSAKSI, KONFIRMASI, GAGAL EMAIL, SEGERA WA: 0821-1190-3090').
tooling: Debrid-Link's own web app, API and JDownloader integration after activation; the reseller adds only payment.
chaining: The Indonesian on-ramp to Debrid-Link at Rp 85,000/month, which is the same service 247PremiumCart sells in India for ₹750 and Debrid-Link sells in euros. Useful as a price comparison across the three resale markets rather than as a distinct capability.

limits.value: manual order; 'Proses 10-30 mnt' on the 360-day tier

limits_note: The shop prints no-refund terms for missing or blocked files: 'kami tidak menerima refund jika file tidak ada atau file diblokir'.
binding_note: Debrid-Link's 400 GB/day is the first number that matters and it is well above 34 GB/day, so a user's own 1 TiB month would not hit it; the resale rail is the practical limit.

identity_cost.detail: Payment is by Indonesian bank only. The site's rail logos are 'BCA, Bank Mandiri, CIMB Niaga, Bank Jago, blu, SeaBank', and Debrid-Link's own reseller directory lists this shop as 'Indonesian - Bank BCA, Bank BNI, Bank CIMB, Bank Mandiri, Local Bank'. A domestic bank account is the gate.

reliability_note: Manual fulfilment with a WhatsApp confirmation path, no refunds for missing or blocked files, and a maintenance banner recording an outage that ended 30 May 2026; the shop is a payment front, not an operator.
confidence_note: Price table and rail list read today, and the rail list is corroborated independently by Debrid-Link's own reseller directory. Whether a foreign card can be used at all is unstated; the bank-only rail list suggests not.

evidence.proved: price table: 'Premium 15 hari Rp 62.000', 'Premium 30 hari Rp 85.000', 'Premium 90 hari Rp 186.000', 'Premium 180 hari Rp 350.000', 'Premium 360 hari Rp 618.000'; 'Bandwidth Limit 400 GB/hari'
rails: 'BCA | Bank Mandiri | CIMB Niaga | Bank Jago | blu | SeaBank'; 'kami tidak menerima refund jika file tidak ada atau file diblokir'
'AgenPremium | Indonesian | Bank BCA, Bank BNI, Bank CIMB, Bank Mandiri, Local Bank' - the provider's own directory confirms the rail set

notes: The cleanest evidence that the Indonesian gate is a bank, not a card: six named domestic banks and no card logo. Abandonment condition: a card rail appears on the site or in Debrid-Link's directory.

extras.provider_directory_row: Debrid-Link lists it as an Indonesian-language reseller with local banks
